headword: {金環|きんかん}{日食|にっしょく}

definitions.explanation: A solar eclipse in which the Moon is too far from Earth to cover the Sun completely, leaving a bright ring of sunlight around its edge.

examples.japanese: {金環|きんかん}{日食|にっしょく}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{珍|めずら}しい→珍しい：01200_mezurashii⟧。
{金環|きんかん}{日食|にっしょく}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{太陽|たいよう}→太陽：03398_taiyou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{指輪|ゆびわ}→指輪：01744_yubiwa⟧⟦のように→のように：30291_noyouni⟧⟦{見|み}える→見える：01165_mieru⟧。
examples.english: In an annular eclipse the Sun looks like a ring.

examples.japanese: ⟦{去年|きょねん}→去年：00727_kyonen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{金環|きんかん}{日食|にっしょく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{観|み}る→観る：22793_miru⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{大勢|おおぜい}→大勢：02850_oozei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{集|あつ}まった→集まる：01162_atsumaru⟧。
examples.english: Crowds gathered to watch last year's annular solar eclipse.

notes:
Composed of {金環|きんかん} (golden ring) + ⟦{日食|にっしょく}→日食：06311_nisshoku⟧ (solar eclipse). The name refers to the ring of sunlight that remains visible around the Moon.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {金環|きんかん}{日食|にっしょく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{観測|かんそく}→観測：00183_kansoku⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to observe an annular solar eclipse
- {金環|きんかん}{日食|にっしょく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{起|お}こる→起こる：01910_okoru⟧: an annular solar eclipse occurs

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{皆既|かいき}{日食|にっしょく}→皆既日食：29532_kaikinisshoku⟧: total eclipse — the Sun is fully covered
- ⟦{部分|ぶぶん}{日食|にっしょく}→部分日食：29533_bubunnisshoku⟧: partial eclipse — only part of the Sun is hidden
